name: ccpm
description: Claude Code plugin marketplace for lovaizu projects

plugins.name: rn
plugins.description: rn makes what you ask for, such as a document, code, or a plugin, so that the people it's for can use it for what they're after. It asks you one point at a time, only what's yours, and leaves one draft pull request for you to merge.

plugins.name: lane
plugins.description: Lane lets an AI notice when it drifts from the steps your plugin gives it, and tells it the right way, so it finds its way back at full speed with no one watching each move.
